request: As a product manager, I want to export the roadmap to CSV so I can share it with finance.
As an engineer, I want to see which deploys went out today, so that I can find what changed before an outage.
As a team lead, I want to archive sprints older than 6 months so the sprint list stays short.
Remind assigned reviewers when a pull request has no review activity
Export the sprint report as a PDF file
Add a Slack integration for deploy notifications
Generate a changelog from merged pull requests
Add a dark theme to the mobile app
Page the on-call engineer when an incident is opened
